questions.stem:
A solution of aluminium chloride is electrolysed for 30 minutes using a current of $2\ \mathrm{A}$. The amount of the aluminium deposited at the cathode is ___ .
[Given : molar mass of aluminium and chlorine are $27\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$ and $35.5\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$ respectively, Faraday constant $= 96500\ \mathrm{C\,mol^{-1}}$].
questions.solution:
gm equivalent of Al deposited $= \frac{It}{96500}$
$\frac{w}{27}\times 3 = \frac{2\times 30\times 60}{96500}$
$w = 0.336\ \mathrm{g}$

questions.stem: Which of the following statement is not true for radioactive decay ?
questions.solution: Decay constant is independent of temperature.

options.text: Amount of radioactive substance remained after three half lives is $\frac{1}{8}$th of original amount.
Decay constant does not depend upon temperature.
Decay constant increases with increase in temperature.
Half life is $\ln 2$ times of $\frac{1}{\text{rate constant}}$.

questions.stem:
How many different stereoisomers are possible for the given molecule ?
$\mathrm{CH_3-CH(OH)-CH=CH-CH_3}$
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{CH_3-CH(OH)-CH=CH-CH_3}$
It has 4 stereoisomers $\begin{bmatrix} R\ cis & R\ trans \\ S\ cis & S\ trans \end{bmatrix}$

questions.solution:

questions.stem:
Lanthanoid ions with $4f^{7}$ configuration are :
(A) $\mathrm{Eu^{2+}}$ (B) $\mathrm{Gd^{3+}}$ (C) $\mathrm{Eu^{3+}}$ (D) $\mathrm{Tb^{3+}}$ (E) $\mathrm{Sm^{2+}}$
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :

Match List-I with List-II
List-I | List-II
(A) $\mathrm{Al^{3+} < Mg^{2+} < Na^{+} < F^{-}}$ | (I) Ionisation Enthalpy
(B) $\mathrm{B < C < O < N}$ | (II) Metallic character
(C) $\mathrm{B < Al < Mg < K}$ | (III) Electronegativity
(D) $\mathrm{Si < P < S < Cl}$ | (IV) Ionic radii
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
Ionic radii – $\mathrm{Al^{3+} < Mg^{2+} < Na^{+} < F^{-}}$
Ionisation energy – $\mathrm{B < C < O < N}$
Metallic character – $\mathrm{B < Al < Mg < K}$
Electron negativity – $\mathrm{Si < P < S < Cl}$

questions.stem: A liquid when kept inside a thermally insulated closed vessel at $25^\circ\mathrm{C}$ was mechanically stirred from outside. What will be the correct option for the following thermodynamic parameters ?
questions.solution:
Thermally insulated $\Rightarrow q = 0$
from I$^{st}$ law
$\Delta U = q + w$
$\Delta U = w$
$w > 0,\ \Delta U > 0$

Given below are two statements :
Statement I : $\mathrm{CH_3-O-CH_2-Cl}$ will undergo $\mathrm{S_N1}$ reaction though it is a primary halide.
Statement II : $\mathrm{(CH_3)_3C-CH_2-Cl}$ will not undergo $\mathrm{S_N2}$ reaction very easily though it is a primary halide.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{CH_3-O-CH_2-Cl}$ will undergo $\mathrm{S_N1}$ mechanism because $\mathrm{CH_3-O-\overset{+}{C}H_2}$ is highly stable.
$\mathrm{(CH_3)_3C-CH_2-Cl}$ (Neopentyl chloride) will undergo $\mathrm{S_N2}$ mechanism at a slow rate because it's sterically crowded

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.

questions.stem:
Given below are two statements :
Statement I : One mole of propyne reacts with excess of sodium to liberate half a mole of $\mathrm{H_2}$ gas.
Statement II : Four g of propyne reacts with $\mathrm{NaNH_2}$ to liberate $\mathrm{NH_3}$ gas which occupies $224\ \mathrm{mL}$ at STP.
In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:
questions.solution:
$\underset{1\,\mathrm{mole}}{\mathrm{CH_3-C\equiv CH}} + \underset{(\mathrm{excess})}{\mathrm{Na}} \rightarrow \mathrm{CH_3-C\equiv \bar{C}\,\overset{+}{Na}} + \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{H_2}\uparrow$ ($\frac{1}{2}$ mole $\mathrm{H_2}$)
$\mathrm{CH_3-C\equiv CH + NaNH_2 \rightarrow CH_3C\equiv \bar{C}\,\overset{+}{Na} + NH_3}$
$4\ \mathrm{gm}$
$\frac{4}{40} = 0.1\ \mathrm{mole}$ ; $\frac{0.1\ \mathrm{mole}}{2240\ \mathrm{mole}}$
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.

questions.stem: A vessel at $1000\ \mathrm{K}$ contains $\mathrm{CO_2}$ with a pressure of $0.5\ \mathrm{atm}$. Some of $\mathrm{CO_2}$ is converted into $\mathrm{CO}$ on addition of graphite. If total pressure at equilibrium is $0.8\ \mathrm{atm}$, then $K_p$ is :
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{CO_2(g) + C(s) \rightleftharpoons 2CO(g)}$
$0.5 \quad - \quad 0$
$0.5 - x \quad 2x$
$P_{total} = 0.5 + x = 0.8$
$x = 0.3$
$K_P = \frac{(0.6)^{2}}{0.2} = 1.8$

questions.stem: In which of the following complexes the CFSE, $\Delta_0$ will be equal to zero?
questions.solution:
For complex $\mathrm{K_3[Fe(SCN)_6]}$
E.C. of $\mathrm{Fe^{3+}}$ – $\mathrm{[Ar]3d^{5}}$
W.F.L. : $t_{2g}^{3}\,e_{g}^{2}$ (each of the three $t_{2g}$ and two $e_g$ orbitals singly occupied)
Calculation of CFSE
$= (-0.4\times 3 + 0.6\times 2)\Delta_0$
$= 0\ \Delta_0$

questions.stem:
Arrange the following solutions in order of their increasing boiling points.
(i) $10^{-4}\ \mathrm{M\ NaCl}$
(ii) $10^{-4}\ \mathrm{M\ Urea}$
(iii) $10^{-3}\ \mathrm{M\ NaCl}$
(iv) $10^{-2}\ \mathrm{M\ NaCl}$
questions.solution:

where $C$ = concentration
Options | i.C.
(i) | $2\times 10^{-4}$
(ii) | $1\times 10^{-4}$
(iii) | $2\times 10^{-3}$
(iv) | $2\times 10^{-2}$

From the magnetic behaviour of $\mathrm{[NiCl_4]^{2-}}$ (paramagnetic) and $\mathrm{[Ni(CO)_4]}$ (diamagnetic), choose the correct geometry and oxidation state.
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{[NiCl_4]^{2-}}$
$\mathrm{Ni^{+2}}$ – $\mathrm{[Ar]\,3d^{8}4s^{0}} \rightarrow sp^{3}$, Tetrahedral
Number of unpaired electron = 2 paramagnetic
$\mathrm{[Ni(CO)_4]}$,

questions.stem:
The incorrect statements regarding geometrical isomerism are :
(A) Propene shows geometrical isomerism.
(B) Trans isomer has identical atoms/groups on the opposite sides of the double bond.
(C) Cis-but-2-ene has higher dipole moment than trans-but-2-ene.
(D) 2-methylbut-2-ene shows two geometrical isomers.
(E) Trans-isomer has lower melting point that cis isomer.
Choose the CORRECT answer from the options given below :

Some $\mathrm{CO_2}$ gas was kept in a sealed container at a pressure of $1\ \mathrm{atm}$ and at $273\ \mathrm{K}$. This entire amount of $\mathrm{CO_2}$ gas was later passed through an aqueous solution of $\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2}$. The excess unreacted $\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2}$ was later neutralized with $0.1\ \mathrm{M}$ of $40\ \mathrm{mL}$ HCl. If the volume of the sealed container of $\mathrm{CO_2}$ was $x$, then $x$ is _____ $\mathrm{cm^{3}}$ (nearest integer).
[Given : The entire amount of $\mathrm{CO_2(g)}$ reacted with exactly half the initial amount of $\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2}$ present in the aqueous solution.]
questions.solution:
Let moles of $\mathrm{CO_2} = n$
moles of $\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2}$ total initially $= 2n$
excess $\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2} = n$
gm equivalent of $\mathrm{Ca(OH)_2}$ = gm equivalent of HCl
$n\times 2 = 0.1\times\frac{40}{1000}\times 1$
$n = 2\times 10^{-3}$
Volume of $\mathrm{CO_2} = 2\times 10^{-3}\times 22400 = 44.8\ \mathrm{cm^{3}}$
